title: Secondary Cryogenic
summary: Secondary Cryogenic   is a Secondary Arcane that adds  Cold status on nearby enemies when inflicting  Puncture status.
extract:
Secondary Cryogenic   is a Secondary Arcane that adds  Cold status on nearby enemies when inflicting  Puncture status.

Effects

Acquisition

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.
Can be bought from Hunhow at Pontis Tower for 10  Emerald Talent and 10  Crimson Talent

Notes
Cold status is applied to all enemies within the radius of the target inflicted with Puncture, i.e., not the radius around the player.
Also applies cold status to the main target.
Does not require line of sight between the main target and surounding enemies.
Cold status effect does not combine with other elements modded on the secondary weapon.
Cold status is affected by Status Duration mods on the secondary weapon.
